rationale: Price is sitting at 94.6% of today's range, just 0.22% below the session high, after recovering from a low of $104.90 — the easy momentum move has already occurred. The last five 1-minute candles show extremely tight, low-volume consolidation with no directional conviction, and the spread plus current positioning near the high creates an unfavorable risk/reward for either a long (chasing near resistance with limited upside to the high) or a short (fading a stock that has already demonstrated strong intraday recovery strength against a weak tape). With an existing working order already consuming buying power and today's realized P&L in the red, the prudent action is to wait for a clearer setup.
